_comment: Translator targets for i18n_schedule.py, tried in plan order (purpose-built translators first, code-specialised codestral last; pin a subset per language with i18n_schedule.py --targets). All are driven ONLY through the canonical umbrella pipeline (translate-pipeline.sh -> HelixTranslate engine, §11.4.255). 'probe' is the OpenAI-compatible base used for a 1-token quota probe after a failure (no translation is done there). Add a target only after one real engine round trip. Dead ones recorded in docs/i18n-providers.md.

targets.note: 2026-11-24: trial key hit 1000 API calls/month (HTTP 429, body says so). Kept as OPTIONAL: set enabled=true (or pin with --targets) once the month rolls over or a production key exists. Best short-UI-string quality of the survey.
works for es fr zh ja ko ar fa hi tr; NOT for sr/be/kk (Latin-script Serbian, Ukrainian for Belarusian/Kazakh); fa phrasing is Arabic-leaning
200000 tokens/day; exhausted on 2026-11-24 (reset ~1 h after the survey); not in any lang plan, last-resort only
ko returns no usable output through the engine; sr is Latin unless the sr_cyrl profile is used
only target that produced real Serbian Cyrillic (sr_cyrl), Belarusian and Kazakh in the 2026-11-24 spot-check; input 7000 tokens/min, 1000 requests/day, 200000 tokens/day
free tier is 2 requests/MINUTE (x-ratelimit-limit-req-minute: 2); the engine makes 1-2 calls per line, so one language would take hours: REVIEWER only, not a translator
code-specialised; spot-check OK for es fr zh ja ko ar hi sr_cyrl be kk, placeholder drift for fa/tr; fallback only

_reviewers_note: reviewer is chosen by the caller of i18n_review.sh <lang> <provider> [model]; the script refuses a provider equal to ANY translator provider in evidence/i18n/<lang>/pipeline.json. Because cohere and groq/mistral/nvidia are now translators too, pin the translator set per language (--targets) so at least one reviewer provider stays independent: cohere-translated languages are reviewed by groq (or mistral), nvidia/groq/mistral-translated languages by cohere.
_plan_note: lang_targets = ordered translator preference per language (sticky: the first available target is used until it fails, then the next). lang_reviewer = reviewer provider (must differ from every translator provider actually used, enforced by i18n_review.sh). Targets with enabled=false are skipped unless named in --targets. day_keys = rate-aware daily key budget per target (UTC day).
